# ECN-2026-013 Change notice - Hot Forge induction billet heater #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-IH02

Reason for change
- Field inspection and preventive maintenance review identified recurrent coil overheating events at EQ-P2-L1-IH02 linked to insufficient cooling flow. Verification against maintenance and safety guidance required an explicit minimum flow specification to prevent coil damage and maintain process stability. This ECN formalizes the preventive parameter and updates control documentation referenced below.

Affected items
- Induction coil assembly and cooling plumbing for EQ-P2-L1-IH02.
- PLC interlock setpoints and operator alarm thresholds that reference coil cooling performance for EQ-P2-L1-IH02.
- Maintenance and SOP documents that guide daily checks and start-up for line P2-L1.

Implementation
- The coil cooling water flow minimum for Hot Forge induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P2-L1-IH02) is 55 L/min. This value shall be programmed into the PLC as the low-flow interlock for EQ-P2-L1-IH02 and displayed on the operator HMI for line P2-L1.
- Update MM-P2-L1-IH02 to include the new minimum flow requirement and inspection criterion for cooling circuit verification during preventive maintenance.
- Update SOP-P2-L1-03 to instruct operators to confirm the HMI indication that flow meets or exceeds the minimum prior to heater start-up for EQ-P2-L1-IH02.
- Issue an immediate work order to verify flow meters and valves for EQ-P2-L1-IH02 and tag any nonconforming devices for correction per MM-P2-L1-IH02.
- Communicate the change to operations and maintenance teams and schedule a toolbox briefing to review the alarm response and shutdown procedure in SB-1001.

Approvals
- Engineering lead approval required for PLC and HMI updates.
- Maintenance manager approval required for execution of work orders and equipment corrections per MM-P2-L1-IH02.
- Operations manager approval required for SOP revisions and crew training acknowledgment referencing SOP-P2-L1-03 and SB-1001.

Document control: Retain ECN-2026-013 and update revision history per plant records.
